_doc: Battle arenas (square, walled: nobody leaves) and the Gate Hall. size in cells of `cell` px; features painted as [x, y, w, h] cell rectangles in order (later ones win); life: hit points of breakable things. you/foe: where the two creatures start. style: how pillars and ground are drawn. fog: short vision. checklist: the sign by its gate.

meadow.name: Meadow
checklist: Hide in tall grass: unseen from range
Attacking from grass reveals you
Ember burns grass, Gale flattens it
Break a cover rock with heavy hits
Wolves are at home in grass

riverbank.name: Riverbank
checklist: Shallow water slows (Tide creatures are faster)
The deep channel can't be crossed
Break the bridge with someone on it
Mud slows everyone
Devils heal slowly in mud

forest.name: Forest
checklist: Fog: you only see what is near
Gale moves clear the fog around them
Trees block shots: use them as pillars
Thickets block movement, not shots
Roots trip a dash

ruins.name: Ruins
checklist: The ledge is high ground: more range and damage
Knockback pushes you off the ledge
Slam a foe into a wall for extra stagger
Thorns hurt whoever is knocked into them
Cracked floor breaks under heavy hits
